courses.name: Data Structures & Algorithms
courses.description: Fundamental linear and non-linear data structures, algorithmic paradigms, and complexity analysis.

courses.name: Operating Systems
courses.description: Operating system concepts, processes, threads, CPU scheduling, concurrency, deadlocks, and memory virtualization.

courses.name: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
courses.description: State space search, game playing, constraint satisfaction, logical inference, and foundational machine learning.

topics.name: Arrays and Dynamic Arrays
topics.description: Contiguous memory allocation, random access time complexity O(1), amortized resizing analysis, and array manipulations.

topics.name: Linked Lists
topics.description: Singly, doubly, and circular linked lists; pointer manipulation, traversal, insertion, deletion, and cycle detection.

topics.name: Stacks and Queues
topics.description: LIFO/FIFO abstract data types, array and pointer implementations, expression parsing, and priority queue primitives.

topics.name: Recursion and Backtracking
topics.description: Recursive calls, base cases, call stack unwinding, recurrence relations, and depth-first exhaustive search.

topics.name: Trees and Binary Search Trees
topics.description: Hierarchical structures, tree traversals (inorder, preorder, postorder), binary search tree invariant, and node operations.

topics.name: Balanced Trees
topics.description: Self-balancing binary search trees (AVL trees, Red-Black trees), tree rotations, and guaranteed O(log n) height.

topics.name: Heaps and Priority Queues
topics.description: Binary min-heaps and max-heaps, complete binary tree array representation, heapify operations, and heapsort.

topics.name: Hash Tables and Hashing
topics.description: Hash functions, collision resolution mechanisms (chaining, open addressing with linear/quadratic probing), and load factor.

topics.name: Graphs and Graph Traversals
topics.description: Adjacency matrix vs adjacency list, breadth-first search (BFS), depth-first search (DFS), and topological sort.

topics.name: Shortest Paths and Minimum Spanning Trees
topics.description: Dijkstra's algorithm, Bellman-Ford, Prim's and Kruskal's algorithms for minimum spanning trees, and disjoint-set union.

topics.name: Sorting and Searching Algorithms
topics.description: Merge sort, quick sort, binary search, counting sort, radix sort, and lower bound of comparison-based sorting.

topics.name: Asymptotic Analysis and Big-O
topics.description: Growth of functions, Big-O, Big-Omega, Big-Theta notations, time and space complexity, and recurrence master theorem.

topics.name: other
topics.description: Non-content slides: syllabus overview, grading policy, exam schedules, book recommendations, title slides, and logistics.

topics.name: OS Architecture and System Calls
topics.description: Kernel vs user mode, dual-mode operation, system calls, interrupt handling, traps, and OS structures (monolithic vs microkernel).

topics.name: Processes and Process Management
topics.description: Process control block (PCB), process state transitions, context switching, process creation (fork/exec), and IPC mechanisms.

topics.name: Threads and Concurrency
topics.description: User-level vs kernel-level threads, multithreading models (M:1, 1:1, M:N), thread pools, and POSIX pthread programming.

topics.name: CPU Scheduling Algorithms
topics.description: Preemptive vs non-preemptive scheduling, FCFS, SJF, Round Robin, Priority Scheduling, and Multi-Level Feedback Queues.

topics.name: Process Synchronization and Mutexes
topics.description: Critical section problem, race conditions, mutual exclusion conditions, Peterson's solution, and hardware atomic instructions.

topics.name: Semaphores and Monitors
topics.description: Counting and binary semaphores, wait() and signal() primitives, condition variables, and classic synchronization problems.

topics.name: Deadlocks
topics.description: Four Coffman conditions, resource allocation graphs, deadlock prevention, avoidance with Banker's algorithm, and detection.

topics.name: Main Memory Management and Paging
topics.description: Contiguous memory allocation, fragmentation (internal/external), paging architecture, page table entries, and TLB caching.

topics.name: Virtual Memory and Page Replacement
topics.description: Demand paging, page faults, Belady's anomaly, FIFO, Optimal, LRU, Second-chance page replacement, and thrashing.

topics.name: File System Interface and Implementation
topics.description: Directory structures, inodes, file allocation methods (contiguous, linked, indexed), free-space management, and journaling.

topics.name: Mass-Storage and Disk Scheduling
topics.description: Magnetic disks, SSD characteristics, RAID levels, and disk arm scheduling algorithms (FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN, LOOK).

topics.name: I/O Systems and Device Management
topics.description: I/O hardware, polling vs interrupts, direct memory access (DMA), kernel I/O subsystem, blocking vs non-blocking I/O.

topics.name: other
topics.description: Non-content slides: course administration, office hours, grading rubric, lab submission guidelines, and title slides.

topics.name: Intelligent Agents and Search
topics.description: Rational agents, PEAS framework, environment types (deterministic, observable), state-space representations, and goal formulations.

topics.name: Uninformed Search
topics.description: Breadth-First Search (BFS), Depth-First Search (DFS), Uniform-Cost Search (UCS), and iterative deepening depth-first search.

topics.name: Informed and Heuristic Search
topics.description: Greedy Best-First Search, A* search, admissible and consistent heuristics, dominance, and heuristic evaluation functions.

topics.name: Adversarial Search and Games
topics.description: Zero-sum two-player games, Minimax theorem, alpha-beta pruning optimization, evaluation functions, and horizon effect.

topics.name: Constraint Satisfaction Problems
topics.description: Variables, domains, and constraints; constraint propagation with AC-3, backtracking search with MRV and forward checking.

topics.name: Propositional and First-Order Logic
topics.description: Syntax and semantics of propositional and predicate logic, CNF conversion, resolution inference rule, and unification.

topics.name: Knowledge Representation and Reasoning
topics.description: Ontologies, semantic networks, frame systems, default reasoning, and rule-based expert systems.

topics.name: Classical Planning
topics.description: STRIPS and PDDL representations, forward state-space search, backward goal-stack planning, and planning graphs.

topics.name: Probabilistic Reasoning and Bayesian Networks
topics.description: Conditional independence, Bayes rule, joint probability distributions, Bayesian network topologies, and d-separation.

topics.name: Supervised Learning: Regression and Classification
topics.description: Linear and logistic regression, decision trees, k-nearest neighbors, naive Bayes, loss functions, and cross-validation.

topics.name: Unsupervised Learning
topics.description: K-means clustering, hierarchical agglomerative clustering, Gaussian mixture models, and principal component analysis (PCA).

topics.name: Neural Networks and Deep Learning
topics.description: Perceptrons, multi-layer feedforward networks, activation functions, backpropagation via gradient descent, and loss landscapes.

topics.name: other
topics.description: Non-content slides: instructor contacts, academic honesty policy, grading scheme, term project logistics, and title slides.
